offering_description.value: Provides college degrees and certificates to military learners, working adults, and students preparing for nursing and other careers. It delivers instruction online and through campuses, with clinical training for nursing students.

primary_services.value: Online undergraduate and graduate education; campus and hybrid nursing education; allied health education; career certificate and diploma programs

customer_segment.value: B2C: Active-duty service members, veterans, working adults, and students pursuing nursing and other career credentials; B2B: Healthcare employers and other organizations that sponsor employee education

end_markets.value: Military and veteran education; adult higher education; nursing and allied health; public safety; business and technology

revenue_model.value: service fees: Tuition and academic fees for degree, diploma, and certificate programs

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Develops curricula and delivers instruction through faculty, online courses, and clinical placements for enrolled students; asset operator: Runs campuses and simulation labs for nursing and other career programs

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with online students abroad and campuses in several U.S. states

specialization.value: related lines: Online degrees across academic disciplines, nursing and allied health programs, and other career credentials

distribution_channels.value: online: University websites and online admissions portals; own locations: University and nursing school campuses; partners / resellers: Employer education partnerships that connect employees with academic programs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State authorization, institutional accreditation, federal student aid oversight, and state nursing board approval of nursing programs
